title: Almost-everywhere and L¹ limit of a sequence with summable L¹ increments (Riesz–Fischer)
statement: Let X be a type with a σ-algebra and a measure μ, let E be a complete normed additive group, and let f_n : X → E (n ∈ ℕ) be μ-a.e. strongly measurable with Σ_n ∫‖f_{n+1} − f_n‖ dμ < ∞ (the sum of the [0, ∞]-valued lintegrals of the extended norms ‖f_{n+1}(x) − f_n(x)‖ₑ is ≠ ∞). Then there is a μ-a.e. strongly measurable g : X → E such that f_n(x) → g(x) for μ-a.e. x and ∫‖f_n − g‖ dμ → 0 as n → ∞ (lintegrals of ‖f_n(x) − g(x)‖ₑ in [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E] (f : ℕ → X → E), (∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (f n) μ) → (∑' n, ∫⁻ x, ‖f (n + 1) x - f n x‖ₑ ∂μ) ≠ ∞ → ∃ g : X → E, AEStronglyMeasurable g μ ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => f n x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) ∧ Tendsto (fun n => ∫⁻ x, ‖f n x - g x‖ₑ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
